content: MASLD evaluation should consider metabolic risk factors and liver-related biomarkers.

section_path: AASLD MASLD Practice Guidance (Stub) > Risk Stratification
locator: AASLD MASLD Practice Guidance (Stub) > Risk Stratification
content:
Non-invasive fibrosis risk stratification is recommended to help prioritize follow-up.
Consider repeat labs and trend analysis when values are borderline.

section_path: AASLD MASLD Practice Guidance (Stub) > Risk Stratification > Fibrosis Assessment Tools
locator: AASLD MASLD Practice Guidance (Stub) > Risk Stratification > Fibrosis Assessment Tools
content: Use non-invasive tools when clinically indicated, and interpret within clinical context.

section_path: AASLD MASLD Practice Guidance (Stub) > Metabolic Risk Factors
locator: AASLD MASLD Practice Guidance (Stub) > Metabolic Risk Factors
content:
Assess adiposity, glycemic status, and lipid markers as part of the risk profile.
Document alcohol intake and activity patterns.

section_path: AASLD MASLD Practice Guidance (Stub) > Lifestyle Counseling
locator: AASLD MASLD Practice Guidance (Stub) > Lifestyle Counseling
content: Lifestyle counseling remains foundational and should be tailored to the individual.

section_path: AASLD MASLD Practice Guidance (Stub) > Follow-up and Monitoring
locator: AASLD MASLD Practice Guidance (Stub) > Follow-up and Monitoring
content: Reassess key labs over time and escalate if there is persistent abnormality.
